A '''training amphistaff''' was made by [[Anakin Solo]] to practice fighting a [[Training droid/Legends|droid]] which moved like a [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. It was designed to act and move like an [[amphistaff]]. The training amphistaff shot dye instead of venom, and instead of hitting an opponent it would simply give them a shock. It was realistic enough that when [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] walked in on Solo training against a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] wielding one and shot it, thinking that Solo was actually under attack.
